s.n: Stakeout salted caramel choc chip cookies
s.note: Kate setting up the camera to catch Santa
s.how: Beat 125g soft butter with 150g brown sugar, 50g caster sugar, 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla. Mix in 220g plain flour, 1/2 tsp bicarb and 120g chopped milk chocolate. Roll into 12 balls, press a soft caramel into the centre of each from a 100g bag and close the dough around it. Chill 20 minutes. Bake at 180C for 11 minutes, sprinkle with sea salt flakes and cool on the tray.

Simmer 500ml beef stock with 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes and 1 tsp Worcestershire for 10 minutes. Drop in 400g thinly sliced deli roast beef for 1 minute to warm through. Split 8 slider buns and dip the cut sides quickly in the jus. Pile in the beef and top with 150g chopped mild pickled vegetables. Serve with little cups of jus for dunking.

m.note: the Pierce family's first Christmas without Dad
m.how: Mix 800g beef mince with 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 60g breadcrumbs soaked in 80ml milk, 2 tsp Worcestershire and salt. Shape into a loaf on a lined tray and wrap with 8 rashers streaky bacon. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes, brush with 4 tbsp tomato sauce mixed with 1 tbsp brown sugar and bake 15 minutes more. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and milk. Make gravy from the tray juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml beef stock.

w.note: the wild sleigh ride across the sky
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 1 tsp vanilla, then mix in 300g plain flour. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm, cut reindeer and stars and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Cool. Mix 250g icing sugar with 2 to 3 tbsp water. Ice the cookies white, tint a little red for noses and finish with gold sprinkles.

d.n: Sleigh ride salted caramel hot chocolate
d.how: Heat 1L full cream milk until steaming, then whisk in 120g chopped milk chocolate and 4 tbsp salted caramel sauce until smooth. Pour into 4 heatproof mugs. Top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream, drizzle with more caramel and add 2 marshmallows each, browned quickly with a kitchen torch or under the grill.
